lineage.description: Injury counts from natural disaster events were extracted from the EM-DAT database maintained by the Centre for Research on the Epidemiology of Disasters (CRED). EM-DAT compiles disaster impact data from multiple sources including UN agencies, governments, and NGOs. The dataset aggregates injured person counts across natural disaster events, likely organized by country and/or year.

sources.name: Centre for Research on the Epidemiology of Disasters (CRED) - EM-DAT
sources.description: EM-DAT is a global database of natural and technological disasters maintained by CRED, recording disaster occurrence and impacts including casualties. It provides the injured counts per disaster event used in this dataset.
